long_biography.plain_text:
Raised on a small farm in Zwevezele, Ide learned metalworking in his parents' forge and noticed weaknesses in agricultural roofing. He founded his own company in 1985 to produce galvanized and pre-coated metal sheets, then broadened the range into steel roof, wall and cladding systems. Acquisitions and plants across Europe turned the venture into a pan-European manufacturer.

Private-equity investment accelerated its expansion while Ide remained a significant shareholder. Kingspan later acquired the group, ending his ownership of the namesake manufacturer. Ide has since co-founded Idelco Insulation, returning to building-products manufacturing, and has allocated capital to listed Belgian companies, including food group Greenyard and flooring producer Belysse.
